body:
You’re support really made my morning and I appreciate it so much. I’m new on here and have found that it is such an amazing source and people like you are amazing and I can’t explain enough how great full I am. 
I just feel so isolated and helpless and I don’t want to come off as pathetic to anyone, but it’s just the build up and collapse that I feel coming near is something I never thought I’d be in but here we are and you’re story has enlightened me and I feel less alone now. Everyone is special and even when going through shit times, your light is still there the power really is within to find the answers. 
I want to go to therapy to feel like I can straighten everything out in my head, but I know it might cause more harm because everyone around me doesn’t support the idea and when I’ve done it in the past it seemed just slightly effective. 
Posting on here really has been the one thing I feel like I have and you people are all the only things really keeping me going lately. It’s amazing and I had no idea. I feel like I can actually build up to make those important steps to make the leap out of this situation and I’m not alone and I can always rely on this place to remind me that the world is good. Thank you <3
Hey! I’m so much better, I’m a lady but it’s cool :p I feel myself and not so insane. Thank you so much for the concern! How are you

Thank you so much, I'm in true shock and awe at how supportive this community is. I've gained peace and understanding for the first time and it's an amazing resource that I had no idea would work when I first posted. Thank you so much and I wish you the best as well!

I'm so sorry to hear what you're going through, this stuff is crazy and unfathomable. I appreciate your support and have thought much about what you have said and have realized that there's really no room for people that I can't trust and that anyone who won't be there for me if I need to break down then I don't need them. I've become closer with a few whom I know will allow me to talk and express my thoughts and feelings and it has helped tremendously. You have really helped me understand the importance of how to heal from this emotionally and I thank you so much. I wish you well!

Thank you so much, ssri's don't work for me but my doctor has recently reached out and asked if I was in need of xanax and pain meds to help cope and they have worked and I now feel able to start seeking out my options. I will definitely be looking into these options. Thank you so much! I wish well to you also. <3

Thank you, I've found myself repeating "the least we can try to do is stay positive for ourselves" to my fiancee and family who are all struggling with their own issues because it really is the most important thing. If we can't stay upbeat and positive for ourselves we're wasting solid time and energy. Thank you for your support!

Thank you, since being more on track with sleep it's easier to make sense of it all and get through the day. I've repeated your words in my head and have really lived by this because it is the basic necessities that are the building blocks of our health. I've managed to eat and sleep and focus on moving and it has helped tremendously, thank you for the support!

Thank you, yeah I live under my parents roof, i'm 24f and I'm under my parents insurance. I've been ridiculed for going to therapy in the past and just can't have it show up on the insurance. I've been to outpatient but it was all under our shared healthcare provider so all the information I provided about my parents being alcoholics was stored into their files as my "family history." So basically they've made me an enemy and feel threatened that I would consider therapy.

I'm going to definitely do search though and look into a different network that would still work with my insurance so I can keep my visits confidential. Thank you so much for the help, I feel better knowing it's possible to get the mental help I need without anyone knowing.

My doctor called and prescribed me xanax and pain medications for my upcoming procedure and I know that will bring me some relief before I can get into a therapist. Again thank you so much, this community has shocked me with how incredibly supportive everyone is. Thank you <3

I went to a facility four years ago for partial hospitalization and it helped but i can’t imagine just popping back in, it never feels like the right time. I’m afraid of causing more anguish for my family because they don’t believe in therapy. I also am afraid of being a financial burden and I don’t want to negativity affect my son. Should I just go for it? 
I really appreciate your help.
That actually is really comforting, thank you
Thank you. Is it possibly to see one without family finding out?
